note: Native PS3 homebrew application (PS3-240P.pkg) compiled and packaged with PS3DK SDK. Standalone XMB launcher with on-screen CRT UI: press Cross for 240p (60 Hz NTSC), Square for 288p (50 Hz PAL), Circle to restore stock interlaced, Triangle to exit to XMB. Volatile RAM only.
